title: The Recipe With No Measurements
central_conflict: the bakery found an old festival recipe with every ingredient listed but no quantities
decisive_choice: faint flour marks on the original measuring bowl showed where each ingredient had once been filled
resolution: tested the bowl marks in a small batch and baked enough bread for the festival
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered the bakery found an old festival recipe with every ingredient listed but no quantities before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they doubled their first mixture, but the dough became too heavy to rise; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.

Rabbit examined the evidence and realized faint flour marks on the original measuring bowl showed where each ingredient had once been filled; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the stranded travelers watching, they tested the bowl marks in a small batch and baked enough bread for the festival, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.

title: The Roof That Whistled
central_conflict: a high whistle from the school roof interrupted every outdoor lesson
decisive_choice: a loose roof vent had a narrow gap that made the wind sing through it
resolution: secured the vent from a safe maintenance platform and brought the class back outside
story_beats: At the library courtyard, fox and rabbit discovered a high whistle from the school roof interrupted every outdoor lesson before the final ferry, leaving the stranded travelers waiting.
Fox attempted an immediate fix, but they shut the classroom windows, but the whistle continued whenever a breeze rose; rabbit stopped the attempt before the situation worsened.
Rabbit examined the evidence and realized a loose roof vent had a narrow gap that made the wind sing through it; together they revised their plan rather than repeating the mistake.

With the stranded travelers watching, they secured the vent from a safe maintenance platform and brought the class back outside, then explained the clue so their neighbors could prevent the problem next time.
